trusted_assumptions: The lower-level LinkedList::<T, A>::new_in contract guarantees that its result has a zero-length sequence view.
The derived Global::default implementation supplies the Global allocator value used by the target initializer.
rationale: Rust 1.96 new_in uses the same field initializer with a supplied allocator. Instantiating it with Global and using sequence extensionality proves the empty view.
